_meta.note: Seed reference data for the RECYCLR agent. Device ids MUST match lib/catalog.ts CATALOG ids exactly. Specs are realistic ranges for mainstream units found in Indian e-waste streams; ranges are honest where the class varies. Battery energy is Wh; 1 Wh ≈ mAh × V / 1000.

air-conditioner.housing: galvanised steel outdoor chassis, ABS indoor cover
air-conditioner.name: Split Air Conditioner
air-conditioner.notes: Richest copper source per kg in the catalog (refrigerant tubing + compressor windings). Refrigerant must be recovered, not vented.

weightKg.typicalNote: catalog typical 22 kg ≈ outdoor unit; combined indoor + outdoor is 35–55 kg

leadContentKg.note: lead oxide in funnel/neck glass of the tube

crt-monitor.name: CRT Monitor
crt-monitor.notes: Legacy class. Funnel glass is ~20–25% lead oxide by weight; panel glass is unleaded. Vacuum implosion risk on the tube.

battery.note: Only a CMOS coin cell — no traction-size battery.

desktop-pc.name: Desktop Tower
desktop-pc.notes: Highest precious-metal density per rupee of scrap: motherboard + connectors. PSU is a separate 1–2 kg unit.

laptop.name: Laptop
laptop.notes: 99.9 Wh is the IATA carry limit — packs above it are rare in consumer waste.

capacityWh.note: 7 Ah × 12 V ≈ 84 Wh up to 150 Ah × 12 V

battery.note: The device IS the battery. ~60% of weight is lead.

dimensionsMm.note: size class varies: 7 Ah UPS ~6 kg, 150 Ah inverter ~40–65 kg

lead-acid-battery.name: Lead-Acid Battery (UPS / Inverter)
lead-acid-battery.notes: Sulphuric acid electrolyte (~30%). Must stay upright; acid is corrosive.

led-tv.housing: HIPS / ABS rear cover, metal mid-frame
led-tv.name: LED TV (32")
led-tv.notes: CCFL-backlit units (pre-2012) carry mercury lamps — treat backlight as hazardous until confirmed LED.

battery.chemistry: Li-ion (LCO / NMC / LFP depending on application)

dimensionsMm.note: power bank ~0.2 kg; laptop pack ~0.4 kg; e-bike pack 2–7 kg

li-ion-battery.housing: plastic pack shell with BMS board
li-ion-battery.name: Li-ion Battery Pack
li-ion-battery.notes: Thermal-runaway risk if punctured, crushed or shorted. Tape terminals; store discharged in fire-safe containment.

dimensionsMm.note: inkjet class; office laser MFPs run 10–25 kg

printer.name: Printer
printer.notes: Toner is fine carbon-black dust — inhalation hazard during dismantling. Inkjet cartridges are mostly plastic.

refrigerator.housing: powder-coated steel cabinet, PU foam insulation, HIPS liner
refrigerator.name: Refrigerator
refrigerator.notes: Refrigerant (HFC-134a or isobutane R600a) + compressor oil are the hazardous fractions. Isobutane is flammable.

smartphone.housing: aluminium frame / glass sandwich; budget units polycarbonate
smartphone.name: Smartphone
smartphone.notes: Battery is ~1/4 of device weight. Puncture risk dominates handling.

tablet.name: Tablet
tablet.notes: Battery is roughly half the device weight; glued-in cells complicate removal.

washing-machine.housing: powder-coated steel body, PP tub, concrete counterweight (front-load)
washing-machine.name: Washing Machine
washing-machine.notes: Motor holds the copper. Run capacitor can hold charge — discharge before dismantling.
